name: Captain Green
identity:
SPROTO #3215, the ONE GREEN/YELLOW superhero creature in reference image 1. Preserve its broad rounded head, long swept OLIVE/LIME GREEN spikes flaring far backward, YELLOW ear interiors, heavy BLUE oval upper eyelids, TWO sleepy solid YELLOW oval visible eye areas with NO BLACK PUPILS, green cheek/eye rim, very broad YELLOW muzzle/chin/neck and a wide curved RED closed smiling mouth. The reference eyes are sleepy yellow ovals under blue lids, never black cartoon pupils. No separate red clown nose. Keep the large cheerful round face and yellow lower jaw from the photo.
COSTUME MUST MATCH THE PHOTO: a broad opaque BLACK high shoulder mantle/yoke draped across the shoulders and upper chest, bright YELLOW fitted chest below it, RED long sleeves, and a RED double-lobed bow-like chest ornament with a small round green-and-silver medallion fixed at its center. This is heroic costume armor/fabric, NOT a business vest or casual jacket. Extend the cropped costume coherently as a fitted YELLOW superhero suit covering abdomen, hips and both legs, simple BLACK waist belt, RED gauntlets with connected fingers and RED knee-high hero boots. The black shoulder mantle flows into a knee-length BLACK superhero CAPE with a RED inner lining, attached behind both shoulders; black outer cape and red lining are readable in folds. All torso/hips/legs are fully clothed. No green bare body, no black ordinary trousers or sneakers, no white shoe soles, no letters/logos, no weapons, no extra jewelry. Same black/yellow/red hero outfit, cape and chest ornament in every pose. The thick RED smiling lips must form a very broad red crescent across the yellow lower face, roughly 65 percent of head width, just like the photo. NO TEETH or tiny thin red mouth.
appearanceRule: Costume continuity is mandatory: BLACK shoulder mantle/cape, YELLOW fitted body AND legs, RED sleeves/gauntlets/boots, central red ornament/round brooch. Cape stays attached, falls with gravity, flares on dash/jump/kicks, stays behind limbs and entirely within each cell. Keep original wide green face, blue eyelids, solid yellow eyes WITHOUT pupils and yellow chin. Crisp pixel shading, no white highlights on black clothing, no floating effects. Exactly one complete body, two connected arms and two legs. Broad thick red lip crescent below the yellow muzzle, closed mouth without teeth. Do not shrink the red lips to a tiny line.
inventoryDescription: Green swept spiky head, blue heavy eyelids, solid yellow eye ovals without black pupils, broad yellow muzzle/chin and red smiling lips. Reference-based heroic clothing: BLACK high shoulder mantle and flowing black cape with red lining, YELLOW fitted chest and fully covered yellow legs, RED sleeves/gauntlets/boots, black belt and original red chest ornament with a round green/silver brooch. One fully clothed body.
visualQA: All 72 core/walk/event drawings reviewed for reference likeness, costume continuity and whole silhouettes. Main-game practice sampled with both revised fighters facing each other; each was also selected as player one and keyboard movement/attacks sampled. Focused gait/combat/throw/special checks, gameplay-preservation checks, full roster power regression and build pass.
